811e237f6461243756f3.en: In the past, everyday news had a clear path. Candidates held press conferences, surveyed markets, organized campaigning, and their headquarters issued press releases that were followed by media coverage. Today, however, the "news flow" created by Shen Boyang has become different: candidates can arrange to go wherever they want today but don't necessarily know what news will pop up from whose phone tomorrow. From Wang Weizhong and Li Xiandan to Zhao Xiaokang's cross-sectional interviews, from the creation of the National Election Committee to street cleaning and university students sharing stories on Facebook, topics are coming one after another. Some even do not come from the campaign team themselves, but rather from community discussions before the media follows them.
